_comment: npm advisories accepted as not exploitable here. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; scripts/check.sh fails on any advisory not listed, and on listed ones once expired. Record each in DECISIONS.md.

exceptions.reason: Build-time only (tailwindcss 3 -> chokidar/micromatch), never shipped or run in production. The DoS needs attacker-controlled glob patterns; the only patterns are this repo's own Tailwind content globs. No patched release exists (3.0.3 is latest). Removed by the Tailwind 4 migration.
